memories.author: D03
memories.text: Reason for visit: hypertension follow-up. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports occasional headaches, otherwise well. EXAMINATION: BP 148/92 mmHg, weight 78 kg, height 1.68 m, BMI 27.6 (obese). Advised diet and activity. IMPRESSION: Hypertension, stage 2. No signs of end-organ damage. ARRANGEMENTS: Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Order fasting lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, serum creatinine/eGFR, potassium, ECG. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (<200 desirable), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40 low), triglycerides 165 mg/dL (<150). Fasting blood sugar: 92 mg/dL (70-100). Serum creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL (0.6-1.2). eGFR: 62 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60 normal). Serum potassium: 4.3 mmol/L (3.5-5.0).

memories.author: D03
memories.text: Resting ECG: Sinus rhythm, rate 78 bpm. No ST-T changes. Left ventricular voltage within normal limits. No Q waves. Normal ECG.

Advised low-salt diet and walking. IMPRESSION: Hypertension, stage 1, borderline controlled. ARRANGEMENTS: Increase amlodipine to 10 mg OD; keep telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Repeat serum creatinine/eGFR and potassium in 6 weeks. memories.author: D03
memories.text: Reason for visit: hypertension check and vaccine. PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient feels well, occasional ankle swelling after long work days. EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 77 kg, BMI 27.3 (overweight). Advised diet, activity, weight reduction. IMPRESSION: Hypertension, controlled; mild peripheral edema likely dependent. ARRANGEMENTS: Stop hydrochlorothiazide due to low potassium trend; continue amlodipine 10 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD. Give inactivated influenza vaccine today (0.5 mL IM). Return if chest pain, dyspnea, fever >39°C, or sudden weight gain.

ARRANGEMENTS: Restart hydrochlorothiazide at 6.25 mg OD to maintain electrolyte balance; keep amlodipine 10 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD. EXAMINATION: BP 130/78 mmHg, weight 76 kg, BMI 26.9 (overweight). Advised continue activity, reduce salt. IMPRESSION: Hypertension, controlled. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or ankle swelling worsening.
